# Compiler

The pipeline has ten stages, `python3 tools/step1.py` to `python3 tools/step10.py`, run in order.

args: What each of the ten tools/step scripts checks by default

- `python3 tools/step1.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p1`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.
- `python3 tools/step2.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p2`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.

- `python3 tools/step4.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p4`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.
- `python3 tools/step5.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p5`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.
- `python3 tools/step6.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p6`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.
- `python3 tools/step7.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p7`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.
- `python3 tools/step8.py` uses an empty default profile, so on its own it checks nothing and still prints a passing line; run it with `--profile p8`, the profile written for that script, which holds every check that script is meant to run on the build it is given.
